name: Customs declaration — complete SAD, every CBAM field present
why: The customs declaration is the most authoritative source for CN code, net mass, origin and MRN. Two RISKS.md N7 defects are fixed here and pinned so they cannot return: _MRN_RE required 20 characters where a real Movement Reference Number is 18, so entry_reference was always None; and the mass capture class admitted whitespace alone, so 'Box 35 Net mass: 24,500.00 kg' matched a single space as the value and the mass was never read.
